title: Presentation data for the strict semilinear scalar comparison
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with Grothendieck topology $J$, let $U\in\mathcal C$, and fix a common coefficient universe supporting module sheafification on $J$ and $J/U$, with the locally bijective characterization of sheafification. Fix a sheaf $O$ of commutative rings, a functor $B:\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Sh}(J,\mathrm{CommRing})$ and a natural transformation $\alpha:\operatorname{const}O\to B$. Use localized extension, scalar restriction, tensors, and strict ring systems as in [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact], [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], [lem-sf-ringed-slice-tensor-generators] and [def-pur-system-level-left-extension-basic]. Define sliceScalarPure to be $b\otimes x$ followed by the actual module-sheafification unit, and restrict $B,\alpha$ termwise to $\mathcal C/U$. A SliceScalarTowerPresentation fixes the actual scalar-extension objects and maps, all pure-tensor transitions, unit insertions and additivity. A SliceSystemExtensionPresentation fixes the actual termwise localized extension, its maps, original-summand transitions and additivity. SemilinearSliceScalarGenerators records these presentations, the natural strict comparison, normalized coefficient-linear components with uniqueness, the summand-preserving scalar identification with uniqueness, the augmentation square and the degreewise unbounded-complex lift. These are the pre-existing data declarations relocated without changing their types or bodies; no existence assertion is made.
